correctness.rationale: For all finite fields q and every m>=2, any proper Heisenberg subalgebra is either a full inverse image of proper W<V or a linear-functional graph on nonzero isotropic W. Nondegeneracy proves Lie generation iff W+W'=V. Gaussian/subspace-complement counting gives D_k, and complementary Lagrangians contribute I_m*q^[m(m+1)/2+2m]/2 because symmetric bilinear forms parametrize their complements. The central projection-zero vertex is isolated; hyperplanes give clique and coloring of size (q^(2m)-1)/(q-1) and a common-neighbor diameter bound. Recomputed integer formulas independently for m=2 and q=2,3,4,5 (including 3805 and 100905 edges). Finite checks only corroborate unrestricted proof.
